title: D-033 design: supervisor-run gate waves and Tier-A acceptance (management-layer absorption plan)
objective: Produce the reviewed design document satisfying D-033-R001 (supervisor-run gate waves: controller dispatches independent read-only reviewer sessions from durable state, records ledger gate records, preserves producer!=reviewer independence and gate classes), D-033-R002 (supervisor-run Tier-A acceptance: submit/gate/accept/queue-advance under ADR-006 preserving every accept() fail-closed precondition incl. DCV rows and content-identity stamps), and D-033-R008 (steady-state operator model: exception handling in short fresh sessions reading only durable state; no new dependence on long-lived chat context). The design must cover: state-machine extensions, reviewer session contracts (how a reviewer identity is spawned, its read-only enforcement, its verdict schema), evidence flow and digests, refusal/failure modes, the owner-gated default-OFF activation switch, machine-enforced separation of duties (D-033-R006 negative-test plan), and the staged R595 activation outline (stages, safeguards, rollback) feeding D-033-R004. Design only - no supervisor code changes in this task.
business_reason: Owner directive D-033: the orchestrator chat session as management layer grows unbounded context and forces handoffs; the deterministic supervisor must absorb the mechanical Tier-A chain behind an owner-gated switch.
inputs: tools/agent_supervisor/loop.py, cli.py, policy.py (current state machine + broker)
acceptance_scenarios: S1 completeness: the design covers every D-033-R001/R002/R008 element named in the objective (state-machine extensions, reviewer session contracts, evidence flow, refusal modes, default-OFF switch, separation-of-duties enforcement plan, staged-activation outline) with no TBD sections.

S2 invariants: for each of ADR-005's authority rules and each accept() fail-closed precondition, the design names the machine enforcement that preserves it under supervisor execution, plus the negative test that would catch its loss (D-033-R006).

S3 honesty about limits: the design explicitly lists what is NOT automatable (G6 qualified-human legal approval, owner-only actions, Tier D / Section 20) and how the controller refuses rather than degrades when it meets one.
S4 staged activation: the R595 package outline defines at least three stages with per-stage evidence requirements, rollback, and the exact owner activation command shape.
path_free_justification: Design-only task: both deliverables (docs/SUPERVISOR_MANAGEMENT_LAYER_DESIGN.md and the producer report) are NEW files that do not exist at contract time, so allowed_paths resolve to zero tracked blobs at HEAD. No production code is in scope; the content identity binds once the deliverables are committed and gated.
